issues: The post covers LLM agent sessions in general: prompt caching costs, attention, and handoffs. Business Central comes up only once, as a passing reference to the base app in a subagent example.

Several key points get the post wrong. It calls handoffs a deliberate cache burn, but the page says they avoid cache invalidation. It also says resumed sessions are billed at full input rates, when the post says the cache-read rate applies.
The integration system has no support in the post.
